item.title: About
item.description:
Hello there! And welcome to my travel blog!

My name is Irina and I’m from Bucharest, the capital of Romania. As you might have already guessed, I love travelling 🙂

Here’s a picture of me and Nessie, the famous Lochness monster 😛

item.title: Contact
item.description:
I’m looking forward to hearing from you! 🙂

The easiest way to reach me is a message on social media:

  • Instagram: @anirib
  • X (Twitter): @anirib

item.title: Privacy policy
item.description:
This is a personal travel blog. It has no user accounts and doesn’t sell or share your data.

If you accept cookies, the site uses Google Analytics to count visits and see which stories are read. You can decline cookies in the cookie banner.

item.title: Travel map
item.description: So far I have been to 42 countries on 3 continents, but I still have loads of places to discover, people to meet, things to learn and awesome sites to visit!
